heroes.0.name: Flame Knight
heroes.0.desc: Stands at the front and clears the way with warm flames for friends.
heroes.0.skillText.row: Swings a flame-wreathed blade sideways to cut down enemies.
heroes.0.skillText.col: Plunges a fire blade down for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.0.skillText.blast: Attacks enemies with flame and wraps itself in a ward.
heroes.0.skillText.star: Strikes all enemies hard with a blazing slash.
heroes.1.name: Frost Mage
heroes.1.desc: A small mage who slows enemies' steps with the power of snowflakes.
heroes.1.skillText.row: Strikes enemies with a cold pulse and slows their next attack.
heroes.1.skillText.col: Stabs one enemy with an ice pillar and slows its next attack.
heroes.1.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with a blizzard and slows their next attack.
heroes.1.skillText.star: Hits all enemies with powerful frost magic and slows them for longer.
heroes.2.name: Forest Archer
heroes.2.desc: Reads the wind and sends arrows exactly where they're needed.
heroes.2.skillText.row: Hits all enemies with a piercing arrow.
heroes.2.skillText.col: Fires a powerful arrow at one enemy.
heroes.2.skillText.blast: Rains arrows down on all enemies.
heroes.2.skillText.star: Deals heavy damage to one enemy with an arrow charged with the World Tree's power.
heroes.3.name: Garden Witch
heroes.3.desc: A witch who tends a small garden. Her blast and ultimate also heal friends.
heroes.3.skillText.row: Sends out a vine in bloom to hit all enemies.
heroes.3.skillText.col: Raises sharp roots to strike one enemy.
heroes.3.skillText.blast: Attacks enemies with petal magic and heals injured friends.
heroes.3.skillText.star: Blooms a magic tree to hit all enemies and heal friends more.
heroes.4.name: Little Blacksmith
heroes.4.desc: A big hammer and a steady heart. Guards itself with its blast skill.
heroes.4.skillText.row: Swings a heavy hammer sideways to hit enemies.
heroes.4.skillText.col: Slams the ground with a hammer for a strong shock on one enemy.
heroes.4.skillText.blast: Shocks all enemies and raises a sturdy shield for itself.
heroes.4.skillText.star: Shakes the ground with a powerful hammer blow, damaging all enemies.
heroes.5.name: Moonlight Rogue
heroes.5.desc: A mischievous guard of the camp's treasures. Her ultimate focuses on one enemy.
heroes.5.skillText.row: Cuts all enemies fast with two blades.
heroes.5.skillText.col: Stabs one enemy with a sharp shadow strike.
heroes.5.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with blades scattering like stars.
heroes.5.skillText.star: Crosses twin blades under the moonlight for heavy damage on one enemy.
heroes.6.name: Wandering Shieldbearer
heroes.6.desc: A shield-bearer with a turtle backpack. Shares the next hit with the most wounded friend.
heroes.6.skillText.row: Pushes with its shell to hit all enemies.
heroes.6.skillText.col: Jabs one enemy hard with a short spear.
heroes.6.skillText.blast: Blocks for a friend, taking their next hit instead.
heroes.6.skillText.star: Opens a safe path for everyone, reducing the next hit.
heroes.7.name: Offbeat Busker
heroes.7.desc: A tiny busker whose hand-bell rhythm helps friends charge up. Shines brightest together.
heroes.7.skillText.row: Hits enemies with a wave of bells and charges the slowest friend.
heroes.7.skillText.col: Hits one enemy with a high note and charges a friend.
heroes.7.skillText.blast: Keeps the beat to boost the next basic attack that goes out.
heroes.7.skillText.star: Hits all enemies with a march and shares charge with two friends.
heroes.8.name: Mushroom Alchemist
heroes.8.desc: Steadily sprinkles aching spores from a tiny potion bottle. Better in long fights than quick weaknesses.
heroes.8.skillText.row: Sprays mushroom spores, leaving light lasting damage on all enemies.
heroes.8.skillText.col: Throws a concentrated potion at one enemy, leaving a more painful spore.
heroes.8.skillText.blast: Bursts a spore pouch, boosting the next spore damage.
heroes.8.skillText.star: A cozy toadstool torments all enemies for a long time.
heroes.9.name: Glass Artisan
heroes.9.desc: Finds the crack in any hard shell or shield. Just an ordinary attacker against unguarded enemies.
heroes.9.skillText.row: Hits all enemies with glass dust.
heroes.9.skillText.col: Stabs a crack awl, great for breaking a defensive stance.
heroes.9.skillText.blast: Peels off one more removable boss shield layer.
heroes.9.skillText.star: Focuses a strong hit on the crack where light gets in.
heroes.10.name: Lightning Courier
heroes.10.desc: Delivers a lightning letter back and forth between two enemies. Damage doesn't spread against a lone boss.
heroes.10.skillText.row: A lightning letter bounces once to another enemy.
heroes.10.skillText.col: Sends a fast express strike to one enemy.
heroes.10.skillText.blast: Lightning travels back and forth between enemies, skipped if there's only one.
heroes.10.skillText.star: An express strike that splits hard between the main target and another enemy.
heroes.11.name: Clockwork Mechanic
heroes.11.desc: Repairs and sets up a small turret for sustained attacks. Only one turret stays active at a time.
heroes.11.skillText.row: Scatters bolts to hit all enemies.
heroes.11.skillText.col: Hits one enemy hard with a compression wrench.
heroes.11.skillText.blast: Sets up a small turret that auto-attacks for 8 seconds.
heroes.11.skillText.star: Sets up a strong turret that keeps pressuring all enemies.
heroes.12.name: Lantern Guide
heroes.12.desc: Briefly halts enemies and lowers the next hit. Only the strongest overlapping shield effect stays.
heroes.12.skillText.row: Hits all enemies with lantern wind.
heroes.12.skillText.col: Briefly slows one enemy's attack with a beacon of light.
heroes.12.skillText.blast: Lowers the next hit on the most wounded ally.
heroes.12.skillText.star: Prepares a safe path for everyone against the next hit.
heroes.13.name: Acorn Tamer
heroes.13.desc: Leaves marks that make friends' direct attacks hurt more. Marks remain if it attacks alone.
heroes.13.skillText.row: Leaves one acorn mark on the main target.
heroes.13.skillText.col: Hits one enemy and adds another mark.
heroes.13.skillText.blast: Leaves two marks ready for a friend to use.
heroes.13.skillText.star: Hits one enemy hard and leaves three marks.
heroes.14.name: Bee Warden
heroes.14.desc: A young beekeeper who has guarded the old oak's hive for generations. Uses the hive lid as a shield and shares a spoonful of honey with hurt friends.
heroes.14.skillText.row: Sprays honey, stirring up a sticky amber wave over all enemies.
heroes.14.skillText.col: Slams a heavy ladle down for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.14.skillText.blast: Raises a hive ward, hitting enemies and shielding itself.
heroes.14.skillText.star: Opens the honey jar wide, hitting all enemies and healing hurt friends.
heroes.15.name: Fern Fanbearer
heroes.15.desc: Picked the biggest fern leaf in the mossy forest shade to make a fan. No extra effects, but sweeps the widest in one go.
heroes.15.skillText.row: Sweeps leaf wind, hitting all enemies in a wide arc.
heroes.15.skillText.col: Plunges the fan tip straight down to hit one enemy.
heroes.15.skillText.blast: Fern leaves spin in a circle, sweeping all enemies.
heroes.15.skillText.star: A wide gust sweeping the whole forest hits all enemies.
heroes.16.name: Pebble Kid
heroes.16.desc: Only picks the smoothest pebbles at the Crystal Canyon's mouth. Piles stones to shield itself, then throws the leftovers.
heroes.16.skillText.row: Scatters gravel sideways to hit all enemies.
heroes.16.skillText.col: Throws a big stone for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.16.skillText.blast: Piles rocks up front, hitting enemies and shielding itself.
heroes.16.skillText.star: Triggers a rockslide for heavy damage on all enemies.
heroes.17.name: Ink Scribe
heroes.17.desc: The last librarian of a fallen library. Marks enemies with ink drops from a big brush that friends' attacks can burst.
heroes.17.skillText.row: Scatters ink, hitting all enemies and leaving a mark.
heroes.17.skillText.col: Draws one stroke for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.17.skillText.blast: Adds a footnote in the margin, hitting all enemies and adding marks.
heroes.17.skillText.star: A finished sentence deals heavy damage to all enemies.
heroes.18.name: Reed Piper
heroes.18.desc: Plays a reed pipe longer than itself in the marsh. Slows enemies with a low tune and scatters thick reed mist.
heroes.18.skillText.row: Hits all enemies with a low tune.
heroes.18.skillText.col: Hits one enemy with a long drawn note and slows its next attack.
heroes.18.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with thick reed mist.
heroes.18.skillText.star: A marsh lullaby deals heavy damage to all enemies.
heroes.19.name: Shell Slinger
heroes.19.desc: A skipping-stone master of the seaside village. A shell that skips like a stone grazes another enemy too, and a big swell smashes one hard.
heroes.19.skillText.row: A skipping shell hits one enemy, and its damage carries to another.
heroes.19.skillText.col: Hits one enemy hard with a crashing wave.
heroes.19.skillText.blast: An incoming tide hits all enemies.
heroes.19.skillText.star: A big swell deals heavy damage to one enemy.
heroes.20.name: Glowmoth Keeper
heroes.20.desc: Tends the moths that light up marsh nights. A flick of their wings scatters glowdust that aches softly for a long time.
heroes.20.skillText.row: Flicks its wings, leaving lasting glowdust damage on all enemies.
heroes.20.skillText.col: Throws a powder clump for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.20.skillText.blast: Spreads a glow ring to hit all enemies.
heroes.20.skillText.star: Calls a night of lanterns for heavy damage on all enemies.
heroes.21.name: Jar Potter
heroes.21.desc: A young potter guarding the desert kiln. Crouches inside a big jar to lower the next hit, and even throws the broken pieces.
heroes.21.skillText.row: Throws broken jar shards to hit all enemies.
heroes.21.skillText.col: Slams a heavy lid down for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.21.skillText.blast: Crouches into the jar, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and lowering the next hit.
heroes.21.skillText.star: A jar fresh from the kiln deals heavy damage to all enemies.
heroes.22.name: Ember Apprentice
heroes.22.desc: A young apprentice at the furnace forge. Scatters embers to burn enemies, and one pump of the bellows boosts the next basic attack.
heroes.22.skillText.row: Scatters embers, hitting all enemies and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.22.skillText.col: Bites one enemy hard with long iron tongs.
heroes.22.skillText.blast: Pumps the bellows once, hitting enemies and boosting the next basic attack.
heroes.22.skillText.star: Gathers the last heat before it burns out for heavy damage on one enemy.
heroes.23.name: Sand Kite Flier
heroes.23.desc: Flies kites the highest in the desert village. Sweeps the string to leave marks, then dives to slow the enemy's next attack.
heroes.23.skillText.row: Sweeps the string, hitting all enemies and leaving a mark.
heroes.23.skillText.col: The kite dives for a strong hit on one enemy and slows its next attack.
heroes.23.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with tangled thread.
heroes.23.skillText.star: Reads the wind for heavy damage on all enemies.
heroes.24.name: Mirror Cat
heroes.24.desc: Gathers crystal cave light in a hand mirror and pins it to one point. No other tricks, but never misses what it aims at once.
heroes.24.skillText.row: Grazes all enemies with thin light.
heroes.24.skillText.col: Plunges a beam of light for heavy damage on one enemy.
heroes.24.skillText.blast: Reflects light every way to hit all enemies.
heroes.24.skillText.star: Gathers scattered light into one point for heavy damage on one enemy.
heroes.25.name: Starseed Keeper
heroes.25.desc: Tends a small patch of garden. Sows seeds to attack, and heals hurt friends every time a sprout breaks through.
heroes.25.skillText.row: Scatters starseeds to hit all enemies.
heroes.25.skillText.col: Plants deep with a sowing stick for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.25.skillText.blast: Sprouts a handspan of growth, hitting enemies and healing hurt friends.
heroes.25.skillText.star: Counts every planted seed for heavy damage on all enemies.
heroes.26.name: Cloud Shepherd
heroes.26.desc: Tends a flock in a corner of the garden. Curls up in a round cloud cushion for a ward, even taking a friend's hit for them.
heroes.26.skillText.row: Rolls a tuft of fluff to hit all enemies.
heroes.26.skillText.col: Lands softly for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.26.skillText.blast: Crouches into a cloud cushion, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and taking a friend's next hit.
heroes.26.skillText.star: A thick cloud blanket deals heavy damage to all enemies.
heroes.27.name: Charcoal Kid
heroes.27.desc: A charcoal kid raised in the furnace district. Wraps embers around its body for a ward, leaving lasting heat damage on enemies.
heroes.27.skillText.row: Flicks lingering ash to hit all enemies.
heroes.27.skillText.col: Hits one enemy hard with a heated fist.
heroes.27.skillText.blast: Wraps embers around itself, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.27.skillText.star: Makes cooling coal glow red again for heavy damage on all enemies.
heroes.28.name: Kelp Diver
heroes.28.desc: A young diver raised by the shore. Whips kelp to bind enemies, then spears a weak point to slow their next attack.
heroes.28.skillText.row: Whips kelp, hitting all enemies and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.28.skillText.col: Spears one enemy for a strong hit and slows its next attack.
heroes.28.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with a tangled kelp forest.
heroes.28.skillText.star: Drags one enemy down to the depths for heavy damage.
heroes.29.name: Mirage Dancer
heroes.29.desc: A dancer of the desert caravan. One twirl of the veil and enemies strike a mirage two steps ahead while the real one slips in.
heroes.29.skillText.row: Grazes with a veil, hitting all enemies and lowering their next hit.
heroes.29.skillText.col: Leaves a mirage while the real one stabs in, hitting one enemy and slowing its next attack.
heroes.29.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with heat haze.
heroes.29.skillText.star: Hits all enemies as if the caravan vanished, boosting the next basic attack.
heroes.30.name: Hearthkeeper
heroes.30.desc: A seasoned hearthkeeper of the furnace district. Heats its armor for a ward and a boosted next basic attack, then unleashes all the stacked heat at once.
heroes.30.skillText.row: Opens the hearth, hitting all enemies and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.30.skillText.col: Drops an anvil for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.30.skillText.blast: Heats its armor, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and boosting the next basic attack.
heroes.30.skillText.star: Unleashes all the stacked heat for heavy damage and lasting damage on all enemies.
heroes.31.name: Marsh Herbalist
heroes.31.desc: Grinds herbs by the marsh. Leaves lasting damage with ground herbs, and heals friends with a brewed tonic.
heroes.31.skillText.row: Grinds and scatters herbs, hitting all enemies and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.31.skillText.col: Feeds a bitter tonic for a strong hit on one enemy and slows its next attack.
heroes.31.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with brewed water and heals hurt friends.
heroes.31.skillText.star: A tonic that's both medicine and poison deals heavy damage and leaves lasting damage on all enemies.
heroes.32.name: Prism Archer
heroes.32.desc: An archer of the Crystal Canyon. Refracts arrows to bounce to another enemy, and marks targets to gather power.
heroes.32.skillText.row: A refracted shot bounces once to another enemy.
heroes.32.skillText.col: Pierces straight down for a strong hit on one enemy and peels a removable boss shield layer.
heroes.32.skillText.blast: Scatters light, hitting all enemies and leaving a mark.
heroes.32.skillText.star: A thrice-bent arrow bounces twice more to other enemies for a strong hit.
heroes.33.name: Steam Porter
heroes.33.desc: A porter of the furnace district. Opens a valve to lower the next hit, and raises a steam wall to take a friend's hit for them.
heroes.33.skillText.row: Opens a valve, hitting all enemies and lowering the next hit.
heroes.33.skillText.col: Drives in a rivet for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.33.skillText.blast: Raises a steam wall, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and taking a friend's next hit.
heroes.33.skillText.star: Releases all the pressure at once for heavy damage on all enemies.
heroes.34.name: Moonlit Gardener
heroes.34.desc: Tends a garden under the moonlight. Heals and shields friends with night dew, and shares energy with the slowest friend.
heroes.34.skillText.row: Sprinkles dew, hitting all enemies and charging the slowest friend.
heroes.34.skillText.col: Raises a stem for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.34.skillText.blast: Hits all enemies with night dew, healing hurt friends and lowering the next hit.
heroes.34.skillText.star: When the primrose blooms, deals heavy damage to all enemies and heals friends.
heroes.35.name: Paper Crane Shaman
heroes.35.desc: A young shaman of the garden shrine. Folds paper cranes to strengthen charms, pursuing enemies steadily like a turret.
heroes.35.skillText.row: Sends paper blades flying to hit all enemies.
heroes.35.skillText.col: Smashes down a charm for a strong hit on one enemy and boosts the next basic attack.
heroes.35.skillText.blast: Folds a paper crane, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and letting the crane auto-attack for 8 seconds.
heroes.35.skillText.star: A thousand cranes deal heavy damage to all enemies and bounce to another enemy.
heroes.36.name: Dune Scout
heroes.36.desc: Scouts ahead of the desert caravan. Leaves marks with harassing shots, then pierces the marked spot with a precise piercing shot.
heroes.36.skillText.row: Hits all enemies with a harassing shot and leaves a mark.
heroes.36.skillText.col: Hits one enemy hard with a piercing aimed shot and slows its next attack.
heroes.36.skillText.blast: Scatters bolts, hitting all enemies and adding marks.
heroes.36.skillText.star: Pierces the marked spot precisely for heavy damage on one enemy and boosts the next basic attack.
heroes.37.name: Waypoint Totem Keeper
heroes.37.emblem: Moss Pillar with a Carved Face
heroes.37.desc: Guards a mossy forest waypoint. Raises a totem pillar to harass enemies and takes a friend’s next hit for them.
heroes.37.skillText.row: Pushes a pillar to hit all enemies.
heroes.37.skillText.col: Plunges down for a strong hit on one enemy and heals a hurt friend.
heroes.37.skillText.blast: Raises a guardian pillar, hitting enemies, shielding itself, and letting the pillar auto-attack for 8 seconds.
heroes.37.skillText.star: Guards the old waypoint for heavy damage on all enemies and takes a friend's next hit.
heroes.38.name: Lantern Fisher
heroes.38.desc: A young fisher of the marshland. Casts a line to leave marks, then snags another enemy with bounced damage.
heroes.38.skillText.row: Casts a line, hitting all enemies and leaving a mark.
heroes.38.skillText.col: Hauls up a strong hit on one enemy and slows its next attack.
heroes.38.skillText.blast: Lures with a lantern, hitting all enemies and leaving a mark.
heroes.38.skillText.star: Snags two on one line for a strong hit that bounces to another enemy.
heroes.39.name: Dawn Shrine Keeper
heroes.39.desc: Alone guards a shrine where the sun first rises. Catches a falling friend once with the light of dawn.
heroes.39.skillText.row: Sweeps a sun-wheel blade sideways across enemies, piercing their defense slightly.
heroes.39.skillText.col: Plunges the sun-wheel blade down, piercing one enemy's defense deeply and slowing its attack.
heroes.39.skillText.blast: Spreads a halo, hitting enemies, raising a ward, and healing friends.
heroes.39.skillText.star: First light hits all enemies, shields friends, and refills the vow.
heroes.40.name: Old Spring Keeper
heroes.40.desc: Guards an old forest spring. Washes away enemy shields and heals, and cleanses friends' poison.
heroes.40.skillText.row: Washes enemies with cold spring water, stripping buffs and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.40.skillText.col: Strikes one enemy with a clear stream, stripping buffs deeply and slowing its attack.
heroes.40.skillText.blast: Overflows the spring, hitting enemies, stripping buffs, and healing friends.
heroes.40.skillText.star: Clears the whole forest, stripping enemy buffs and washing away friends' poison.
heroes.41.name: Constellation Rider
heroes.41.desc: A rider carrying a constellation banner. When it rises, even fallen friends find the strength to stand again.
heroes.41.skillText.row: Signals with the banner, hitting enemies and charging all friends.
heroes.41.skillText.col: Plunges the banner's staff for a strong hit on one enemy and boosts the next basic attack.
heroes.41.skillText.blast: Gathers friends under the stars, hitting enemies, healing, and charging everyone.
heroes.41.skillText.star: A full rally signal hits all enemies and charges even fallen friends heavily.
heroes.42.name: Shadow Puppeteer
heroes.42.emblem: Small Shadow Puppet on a Rod
heroes.42.desc: A puppeteer of the lantern theater. The puppet mimics the same move a beat late, making a popped special block appear once more.
heroes.42.skillText.row: Slashes twice with the puppet, leaving marks on enemies.
heroes.42.skillText.col: Stabs together with the puppet, piercing one enemy's defense.
heroes.42.skillText.blast: Rings the stage, hitting enemies and linking damage to another enemy.
heroes.42.skillText.star: Slashes the same spot twice for heavy damage on one enemy and links it to another.
heroes.43.name: Clocktower Keeper
heroes.43.desc: Once tended the bell at the top of the clocktower. When the minute hand stops, enemies briefly hold their breath.
heroes.43.skillText.row: Sweeps the second hand across enemies, slowing their next attack.
heroes.43.skillText.col: Plunges the minute hand down, slowing one enemy's next attack heavily.
heroes.43.skillText.blast: Turns the hands backward, hitting enemies, shielding friends, and boosting the next basic attack.
heroes.43.skillText.star: Midnight's bell hits all enemies and briefly stops all enemies' time.
heroes.44.name: Lasso Cowboy
heroes.44.desc: An easygoing kid from a prairie ranch. The moment a friend is attacked, he throws his lasso faster than anyone and strikes back.
heroes.44.skillText.row: Swings the rope wide to hit all enemies and delay their next attacks.
heroes.44.skillText.col: Throws a lasso for a strong hit on one enemy and takes a lasso stance.
heroes.44.skillText.blast: Guards the campfire, hitting enemies, shielding himself, and lowering the most hurt friend’s next hit.
heroes.44.skillText.star: A rodeo round deals heavy damage to all enemies, takes a friend’s next hit, and sets a strong lasso stance.
heroes.45.name: Adventure Photographer
heroes.45.desc: A brave photographer raised in a traveling photo studio. Blocks the front with a reflector shield and develops every mark left on enemies in one flash.
heroes.45.skillText.row: Presses the shutter to hit all enemies and leave a mark.
heroes.45.skillText.col: Fires the flash for a strong hit on one enemy and takes a friend’s next hit.
heroes.45.skillText.blast: Shoots a burst to hit enemies and leave marks, shielding herself and lowering the most hurt friend’s next hit.
heroes.45.skillText.star: Develops the photos for heavy damage to all enemies, pops every remaining mark at once, and takes a friend’s next hit.
heroes.46.name: Frying Pan Chef
heroes.46.emblem: Iron Pan with a Fried Egg
heroes.46.desc: A sturdy little chef who makes sure everyone eats before a fight. Blocks with an iron pan and shares snacks to power up friends.
heroes.46.skillText.row: Swings the iron pan to hit all enemies and lower the most hurt friend’s next hit.
heroes.46.skillText.col: Strikes one enemy hard, like seasoning just right, and boosts the next normal attack.
heroes.46.skillText.blast: Shares a bite-size snack, hitting enemies, shielding himself, and giving one friend Charge.
heroes.46.skillText.star: Lays out a full spread for heavy damage to all enemies and gives one friend Charge.
heroes.47.name: Sewing Apprentice
heroes.47.desc: A meticulous apprentice from the sewing room beside the fallen library. She can’t stand a torn seam and pierces even tough enemies with her needle.
heroes.47.skillText.row: Threads the needle to stab one enemy and chain the hit to another.
heroes.47.skillText.col: Stitches deep for a strong hit on one enemy, piercing its defenses.
heroes.47.skillText.blast: Scatters prickly needles, hitting enemies and leaving lasting damage.
heroes.47.skillText.star: Sews with all her might for heavy damage to one enemy, piercing defenses and chaining to another.
heroes.48.name: Spinning Top Champ
heroes.48.desc: The neighborhood spinning-top champion who hates to lose. Once his top is spinning, it keeps pecking at enemies on its own.
heroes.48.skillText.row: Tosses a top to hit all enemies.
heroes.48.skillText.col: Slams a top down for a strong hit on one enemy.
heroes.48.skillText.blast: Sets a top spinning to hit one enemy, and it auto-attacks for 8 seconds.
heroes.48.skillText.star: A top whirlwind deals heavy damage to all enemies, and the top auto-attacks for 8 seconds.
heroes.49.name: Fireworks Artisan
heroes.49.desc: Daughter of a fireworks artisan from a summer-festival town. She dreams of turning the summer night sky into a flower field, so she lights fuses on enemies and sets them popping.
heroes.49.skillText.row: Scatters embers to hit all enemies and light fuses on them.
heroes.49.skillText.col: Launches a firework for a strong hit on one enemy and lights a big fuse.
heroes.49.skillText.blast: Stardust sparks hit enemies and leave lasting damage.
heroes.49.skillText.star: A thousand fireworks bloom for heavy damage to all enemies, light fuses, and boost the next normal attack.
heroes.50.name: Teddy Knight
heroes.50.desc: A timid kid from the toy attic. Hugging her teddy makes her braver than anyone, and the teddy draws enemy attacks to her.
heroes.50.skillText.row: Pats all enemies with a cotton bat and lowers the most hurt friend’s next hit.
heroes.50.skillText.col: Squishes down for a strong hit on one enemy and delays its next attack.
heroes.50.skillText.blast: Builds a cozy wall, hitting enemies, shielding herself, and drawing enemy attacks with a teddy decoy.
heroes.50.skillText.star: With her big bear buddy, deals heavy damage to all enemies, heals friends, and draws enemy attacks for a long time.
heroes.51.name: Rain Umbrella Keeper
heroes.51.desc: A calm umbrella keeper who lives by the marsh. She loves rainy days most of all and heals friends with a gentle rain.
heroes.51.skillText.row: Rain streaks hit all enemies and delay their next attacks.
heroes.51.skillText.col: Opens the umbrella to hit one enemy and lower the most hurt friend’s next hit.
heroes.51.skillText.blast: Brings a gentle rain, hitting enemies and healing friends.
heroes.51.skillText.star: Ends the shower for heavy damage to all enemies and a big heal for friends.
heroes.52.name: Candy Seller
heroes.52.desc: A kid from the garden shop whose pockets always bulge with candy. Generous to a fault, she shares candy to fill friends with energy.
heroes.52.skillText.row: Shares candy while hitting all enemies and gives one friend Charge.
heroes.52.skillText.col: Taps one enemy with a lollipop for a strong hit.
heroes.52.skillText.star: A big candy party deals heavy damage to all enemies and gives one friend a lot of Charge.
heroes.53.name: Water Cannon Firefighter
heroes.53.desc: A plucky firefighter from the furnace town. At the first whiff of smoke she’s the first to rush in and push enemies back with her water cannon.
heroes.53.skillText.row: Sprays water to hit all enemies.
heroes.53.skillText.col: Pushes one enemy back with a water jet for a strong hit and greatly delays its next attack.
heroes.53.skillText.blast: Raises a water barrier, hitting enemies and shielding herself.
heroes.53.skillText.star: A full blast deals heavy damage to all enemies and delays their next attacks.
heroes.54.name: Oasis Falconer
heroes.54.desc: A dignified falconer who grew up with his falcon at an oasis. They talk with just a look, and the falcon is first to spot a weakened enemy.
heroes.54.skillText.row: Releases the falcon to hit all enemies and leave a mark.
heroes.54.skillText.col: The falcon dives for a strong hit on one enemy, piercing its defenses.
heroes.54.skillText.blast: Starts the hunt, hitting enemies, and the falcon targets weak enemies for 8 seconds.
heroes.54.skillText.star: The falcon soars for heavy damage to one enemy, chains to another, and hunts weak enemies.
heroes.55.name: Snow Peak Rescuer
heroes.55.desc: The youngest of the crystal snow-peak rescue team. He can’t pass by anyone lost, and guards friends while breaking ice walls with his ice axe.
heroes.55.skillText.row: Throws snowballs to hit all enemies and delay their next attacks.
heroes.55.skillText.col: Strikes one enemy with the ice axe for a strong hit, piercing its defenses.
heroes.55.skillText.blast: Throws a rescue rope, hitting enemies, shielding himself, and taking a friend’s next hit.
heroes.55.skillText.star: Smashes the ice wall for heavy damage to all enemies, piercing their defenses.
heroes.56.name: Magnet Inventor
heroes.56.desc: A scatterbrained inventor from the furnace town. He builds whatever pops into his head, and can set up a magnet turret in a snap.
heroes.56.skillText.row: Magnetic marks hit all enemies and leave a mark.
heroes.56.skillText.col: Rips off scrap metal for a strong hit on one enemy and strips a boss’s protective layer.
heroes.56.skillText.blast: Sets up a magnet turret to hit one enemy, and it auto-attacks for 8 seconds.
heroes.56.skillText.star: A magnetic storm deals heavy damage to all enemies, and the turret auto-attacks for 8 seconds.
heroes.57.name: Fossil Digger
heroes.57.desc: A tireless fossil detective from the mossy-forest dig site. He doesn’t mind getting dirty and cracks even hard shells with a bone.
heroes.57.skillText.row: Dusts off dirt to hit all enemies.
heroes.57.skillText.col: Slams down a fossil bone for a strong hit on one enemy, piercing its defenses.
heroes.57.skillText.blast: Turns over the dig site to hit enemies.
heroes.57.skillText.star: The joy of a big discovery deals heavy damage to one enemy, piercing its defenses.
heroes.58.name: Paint Artist
heroes.58.desc: A chatty painter from the garden who itches to color everything. Paints friends’ weapons to make their next attack stronger.
heroes.58.skillText.row: Splashes paint to hit all enemies.
heroes.58.skillText.col: Dabs one enemy with a brush for a strong hit.
heroes.58.skillText.blast: Adds color, hitting enemies and boosting the next normal attack.
heroes.58.skillText.star: Completes a masterpiece for heavy damage to all enemies and boosts the next normal attack.

lore.skillEffect.delay: Extends the time until the hit enemy's next attack by {delay} seconds. The remaining time won't exceed that enemy's basic attack interval + {delayCap} seconds.
lore.skillEffect.shield: Adds {shield} shield to itself. The shield absorbs damage first, capped at 40% of its own max HP.
lore.skillEffect.heal: Restores a total of {heal} HP to surviving allies. It fills the ally with the lowest HP percentage up to their max HP first, then shares the rest with the next ally. Not everyone gets exactly {heal}.
lore.skillEffect.guard: {short} takes {guardPct}% of the next hit meant for the most wounded other ally instead. At most 15% of {short}'s max HP can be transferred at once.
lore.skillEffect.mitigation: Lowers the most wounded ally's next hit by {pct}%. If it overlaps with another protection effect, only the stronger one applies.
lore.skillEffect.support: Gives +{support} charge to whichever other hero has the lowest charge. Charge adds to the next basic attack, and every 9 triggers a basic attack right away.
lore.skillEffect.normalBoost: Adds {pct}% of attack power as bonus damage to the next basic attack that goes out. Applies only once no matter who attacks first, including itself.
lore.skillEffect.dot: After a hit, deals {pct}% of attack power as damage every 2 seconds, up to 3 times. Only one lasting damage effect is kept per enemy, refreshed to the stronger value.
lore.skillEffect.pierce: Ignores {pct}% of the damage reduction from enemy traits. Only affects damage-reducing enemies like acorn armor, crystal shield layers, sand burrowing, or cloud guard.
lore.skillEffect.breakLayer: Peels {breakLayer} more removable shield layers allowed by the boss's rules.
lore.skillEffect.chain: Only when there are multiple targets, damage bounces to {chainLen} other enemies. Damage from missing targets doesn't pile onto the main target.
lore.skillEffect.turret: Keeps one turret active for 8 seconds, dealing {pct}% of attack power 4 times every 2 seconds. Only one turret stays active at a time, and it disappears if the hero who placed it falls.
lore.skillEffect.mark: Leaves {mark} marks on {aoeTarget, select, all{all hit enemies} other{the main target}}. Another hero's direct attack consumes one mark for 60% of the marking hero's attack as bonus damage.
lore.skillEffect.purge: Burns {purge} trait activations (up to 3) from the hit enemy and strips its shield. Only affects regen, healer, ward, and support traits.
lore.skillEffect.rally: Gives +{rally} charge to every hero, including fallen ones. Fallen allies receive it as revive energy.
lore.skillEffect.stasis: Stops all enemy attack and trait timers, plus boss warning timers, for {stasis} seconds. Overlapping uses refresh to the longer duration. Weak point windows aren't stopped.
lore.skillEffect.vow: If the vow was spent, refills it (triggers at most twice per battle).
lore.skillEffect.echo: When this skill triggers, after the current turn ends, one matching-emblem block turns into the same special block. Only one echo block exists at a time and it doesn't create another echo.
lore.skillEffect.lasso: Takes a lasso stance for 6 seconds. If an enemy makes a single-target attack on an ally during that time, cuts that damage by 40%, counters the attacker for {pct}% of attack power, and delays its next attack by 1.5 seconds.
lore.skillEffect.taunt: For {taunt} seconds, every single-target enemy attack goes to {short}. Setting the decoy also gives {short} a shield worth 20% of max HP.
lore.skillEffect.fuse: Attaches a fuse to each hit enemy that bursts after 2 seconds, dealing {pct}% of attack power to that enemy and half that to every other enemy. Each enemy keeps only one fuse, refreshed to the larger value.
lore.skillEffect.hunt: The falcon hunts for 8 seconds, striking the enemy with the lowest HP ratio every 2 seconds for {pct}% of attack power, 4 times. When the falcon defeats an enemy, every hero gains +1 Charge (up to 4 times per battle).
lore.skillEffect.develop: Pops every mark left on the hit enemy at once. Each mark deals 60% of the marking hero’s attack, or this hero’s attack if that hero is absent.

lore.glossary.terms.legendaryOpening.des: Legendary heroes get charge at battle start, strengthening their first basic attack.
lore.glossary.terms.crit.name: Critical Hit
lore.glossary.terms.crit.desc: Each basic attack has a 10% chance for 1.5x damage. Lands more with 4-5 matches and chains.
lore.glossary.terms.revive.name: Revive Gauge
lore.glossary.terms.revive.desc: Matching the same color raises the revive count (skills +5). At 9, they revive (45%).
lore.glossary.terms.matchChain.name: Chain (Match)
lore.glossary.terms.matchChain.desc: Longer chains make basic attacks, heals, and shields stronger (up to ×2.5).
lore.glossary.terms.specialBlock.name: Special Block
lore.glossary.terms.specialBlock.desc: Created by matching 4 or more. Touch or swap it to trigger the skill.
lore.glossary.terms.token.name: Token
lore.glossary.terms.token.desc: Earned from missions, login streaks, expeditions, bosses, achievements, and leveling up.
lore.glossary.terms.renown.name: Renown
lore.glossary.terms.renown.desc: Rises as you grow more heroes. Increases party HP.
lore.glossary.terms.relic.name: Relic
lore.glossary.terms.relic.desc: A permanent upgrade effect you pick and stack on each expedition floor.
lore.glossary.terms.coreRelic.name: Core Relic
lore.glossary.terms.coreRelic.desc: A powerful relic chosen every 10 floors; you can only hold 1.
lore.glossary.terms.expedition.name: Endless Expedition
lore.glossary.terms.expedition.desc: A challenge to climb floors and stack relics; gold stays even if you're wiped.
lore.glossary.terms.mastery.name: Mastery Challenge
lore.glossary.terms.mastery.desc: A boss fight with a chosen difficulty; has a level requirement.
lore.glossary.terms.featuredHero.name: Today's Hero
lore.glossary.terms.featuredHero.desc: Win with them for +30% gold per hero (up to 3 wins a day).
lore.glossary.terms.skin.name: Skin
lore.glossary.terms.skin.desc: A cosmetic that changes a hero's look; doesn't affect combat power.
lore.glossary.terms.crit.descOn: 1.5x basic attack damage. The chance differs per hero. Rises with 4-5 matches and chains.

shell.onboarding.card1.title: Match the Same Emblems

shell.onboarding.card2.body: Match 4 or more emblems to create a sparkling special block. Tap it to unleash a powerful skill. Heart blocks heal your most injured hero, and shield blocks protect a hero from the next hit.

shell.onboarding.card3.body: Train heroes and welcome new friends at camp. Clear stages on the adventure map to unlock the endless expedition and mastery challenges. Tap Set Out and we'll guide you through your first battle.
